theme: An open day, with room for the bookings that have slipped.

needsAttention.title: December trip still undecided
needsAttention.detail: The Dec 13–Jan 2 trip for all four kids was due to be decided Sept 30 and booked by Oct 15 — holiday inventory for six is thinnest right now. Pick the domestic shortlist (passports land in November) or international on refundable bookings only.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: The Pathfinder heads south this month, leaving no six-seater in Maine for Christmas. A full-size SUV out of Portland over the holidays sells out; a refundable hold now costs nothing and closes the risk.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 off-week is the planned Portland-to-St-Pete drive. The one hotel night en route still needs booking before the weekend is out.

recipe.title: Lamb Shanks with Crushed Roots

acts.line: A clear run until mid-afternoon — the kind of open morning the overdue travel bookings have been waiting for.
Pema calls at 2:30; an hour set aside and the rest of the afternoon stays loose.
Nothing on the calendar after the call — the evening is yours to shape, girls still around through the weekend.
